newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm on cash-connected pricing.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm on cash-connected pricing.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed firm as small-lot, cash-connected pricing began moving the market up from near the bottom of a trading range, traders said.
"There is still good pricing under the market," a trader said, but the buying was not heavy nor aggressive.
Traders said position-squaring before Thursday, first notice day for deliveries on the November contract, contributed to the advances.
"We're still in a trading range from $9.80 to $10.00 (per cwt) in the November," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, about the same as the 302 Monday. Rice options volume was estimated at 75, down from 128 Monday.
Rice futures closed unchanged to four cents per cwt higher, with November unchanged at $9.87.
